rationale:
Issue #126 describes a race condition where Simulator.reset() does not wait for simulation to complete, causing '_simulationEndRequested after reset is not set for run loop causing simulation to keep running even after it was asked to be ended.' The minimized production patch adds exactly 2 lines to the reset() method to await simulationEnded when _simulationEndRequested is true, directly addressing the race condition. The trigger test exercises the exact defect scenario by calling endSimulation(), reset(), and another action at the same timestamp, then running the simulation. Strict runtime validation confirms: (1) the test fails/hangs on buggy revision 67ecc3816f4, (2) passes cleanly on fixed revision 22c80a64926, (3) is deterministic across 3 repetitions, (4) the full suite on buggy reproduces only this trigger, and (5) the fixed version passes all tests. The trigger is semantically equivalent to the reported defect—both exercise the endSimulation+reset race condition without introducing new APIs. No active duplicates exist in the same project.

Issue #126 describes a race condition where Simulator.reset() does not wait for simulation to complete, causing stale simulation to continue running. The production fix adds 2 lines to reset() method that await simulationEnded if _simulationEndRequested is true before resetting state. The trigger test exercises this exact scenario by registering three actions at timestamp 100: endSimulation(), reset(), and a third action, then running the simulator. Runtime evidence confirms the test fails deterministically on buggy revision (reproduced across 3 repetitions) and passes cleanly on fixed revision. The minimized production patch contains only the synchronization fix with no refactoring, formatting, or unrelated changes. The trigger test uses only pre-existing public Simulator API (registerAction, endSimulation, reset, run) present in the parent commit. No duplicate root causes exist in the active registry for this project.
